//max_lines: Total lines visible at once (2 = 2x2 layout)
//hold_previous_words: Keeps past words visible until sentence ends
//pause_aware: If true, subtitles stay on screen during short pauses
//margin_vertical_px: Distance from bottom/top depending on alignment

highlight.//background_enabled: Draw background box only for active word

//highlight_pop: Subtle scale animation on active word

logo.//: Logo display settings. Path is provided via CLI argument, not here.
logo.//corner: Placement corner: top-left | top-right | bottom-left | bottom-right
logo.//width_pct: Logo width as fraction of output frame width (1080px). 0.12 = ~130px wide.
logo.//margin_x: Horizontal margin in pixels from the chosen edge
logo.//margin_y: Vertical margin in pixels from the chosen edge

processing.//: Tuning knobs for all pipeline steps. Changing these requires --regen-splits.

scene_detection.//sample_fps: How many times per second to sample frames for cut detection. Framerate-agnostic — 10 samples/s works for 30fps and 120fps equally.
scene_detection.//diff_threshold: Mean pixel diff (0-255) between samples to trigger a scene cut. Lower = more sensitive. Default 22 works for most content.
scene_detection.//min_duration_sec: Discard detected scenes shorter than this. Filters out flash cuts.

motion_analysis.//motion_threshold: Mean pixel energy above which a scene is classified as animated (uses motion centroid). Below this, saliency is tried.
motion_analysis.//sample_fps: Frames per second to sample when analysing crop center.
motion_analysis.//pixel_diff_threshold: Per-pixel diff (0-255) to count a pixel as moving during motion analysis.
motion_analysis.//saliency_center_deadband: If saliency returns a point within this fraction of dead-center, it is rejected and center fallback is used instead.

background_blur.//: Blur applied to the background fill behind the portrait crop window (landscape sources only).
background_blur.//opencv_kernel_size: Must be odd. Increase for a heavier blur.

zoom_out.//: Zoom-out outro appended to each scene (landscape sources only). Disabled automatically for portrait sources.
zoom_out.//enabled: Set false to disable entirely for all scenes.
zoom_out.//max_pct_of_scene: Cap zoom duration as a fraction of scene length. Prevents short scenes from being mostly zoom.

encode.//crf_precrop: CRF quality for the pre-crop intermediate (Step 0). Lower = better quality, larger file.
encode.//crf_scenes: CRF quality for split scenes and final burns.
encode.//audio_bitrate: AAC audio bitrate for all encoded outputs.
encode.//preset: ffmpeg encode speed preset. fast=good balance. slower=smaller files. ultrafast=fastest.
